nodes.label: Mirathorn communications failure
nodes.description: Repeated attempts to contact Mirathorn fail, forcing the group to rely on indirect communication through trusted contacts and a silver raven message.

evidence_refs.label: Mirathorn communications failure

nodes.label: City corruption outbreak and compromised figures
nodes.description: Grobnok reports a renewed outbreak of corrupted meat, decimated city guards, compromised Frank, and Sara missing, implying an unresolved internal crisis in Mirathorn.

evidence_refs.label: City corruption outbreak and compromised figures

nodes.label: Mysterious music drawing people into the swamp
nodes.description: Reports from Private Hester and later group observations point to strange music influencing people to walk into the swamp without responding when stopped.

evidence_refs.label: Mysterious music drawing people into the swamp
Mysterious music drawing people into the swamp

nodes.label: Shared humming of the Dustwalker song
nodes.description: The party independently begins humming the same song, identified as the rhythm heard the previous night and the Dustwalker’s festival performance, suggesting an active enchantment or lingering influence.

evidence_refs.label: Shared humming of the Dustwalker song
Shared humming of the Dustwalker song

nodes.label: Recently abandoned restaurant with cryptic sign
nodes.description: An abandoned meat-on-a-stick restaurant appears to have been vacated within the past week, with its menu erased and replaced by the message 'headed south, north wrong,' implying a recent warning or forced evacuation.

evidence_refs.label: Recently abandoned restaurant with cryptic sign

nodes.label: Knocking on a door that cannot be found
nodes.description: Karsemine hears knocking on a door after the storm, but cannot locate any source or even find a door, indicating a potentially supernatural or illusory phenomenon.

evidence_refs.label: Knocking on a door that cannot be found

nodes.label: Shepherd cult recruitment inside the city
nodes.description: The 'meat heads' are becoming more open in recruiting for the Shepherd, and a gnome now shows shimmering eyes despite that infection pattern previously being associated only with humans.

evidence_refs.label: Shepherd cult recruitment inside the city

nodes.label: Lysandra's true mission and leadership resolve
nodes.description: Under magical questioning, Lysandra states her intention is to keep the team focused on reaching the swamp and destroying the cult source, but her broader motivations and fit as leader remain under scrutiny.

evidence_refs.label: Lysandra's true mission and leadership resolve
Lysandra's true mission and leadership resolve

nodes.label: Lysandro encountered at the wall
nodes.description: The party reaches a guarded wall at night and meets a man identified as Lysandra's father, Lysandro, creating a new personal and political connection at the boundary.

evidence_refs.label: Lysandro encountered at the wall
Lysandro encountered at the wall

beats.title: Route shifts toward the Reach and Mireward
beats.summary: The group pivots from Mirathorn to the northern Reach and prepares to continue toward Mireward, with an ominous storm system already building around them and a damp, magical trail underfoot.

evidence_refs.label: Route shifts toward the Reach and Mireward

beats.title: Failed city contact leads to a new messaging plan
beats.summary: After another unsuccessful attempt to reach Mirathorn, the party decides to contact trusted intermediaries instead: Professor Tealeaf, and Grobnok with an encoded backup message, sent by silver raven.

evidence_refs.label: Failed city contact leads to a new messaging plan

beats.title: Travel reveals magical anomalies and social tension
beats.summary: On the road, the storm worsens and the party notices delayed reflections in puddles. Their conversation also surfaces distrust and personal tensions, especially around lies and Lysandra.

evidence_refs.label: Travel reveals magical anomalies and social tension

beats.title: Private Hester warns of swamp corruption
beats.summary: The group meets Private Hester, a Reach soldier carrying reports to Mirathorn. She reports mysterious music, people walking into the swamp unresponsive, and warns that a much larger force may be needed before urging them to speak to Commander Vale.

evidence_refs.label: Private Hester warns of swamp corruption

beats.title: Puddle magic is investigated at camp
beats.summary: While searching for camp, the party studies the strange puddles. Caelynn detects conjuration magic and they briefly test the water, but nothing changes, so they continue looking for a safe place to stop.

evidence_refs.label: Puddle magic is investigated at camp

beats.title: Grobnok confirms the city crisis has worsened
beats.summary: At camp, the vial is analyzed and the puddle phenomenon is interpreted as planar bleed or conjuration. Grobnok then contacts the group to report renewed corruption outbreaks in the city, compromised personnel, mercenaries on hire, and instructions to continue to the swamp while he remains the sole point of contact.

evidence_refs.label: Grobnok confirms the city crisis has worsened

beats.title: Night watch reveals storm, mist, and a hum
beats.summary: The party endures a quiet night until a familiar savory mist rises at dawn. With no further contact from Grobnok, they set out again and learn that the approaching weather has become a major hailstorm, prompting a hurry for shelter.

evidence_refs.label: Night watch reveals storm, mist, and a hum

beats.title: Morale lifts, and the shared song is recognized
beats.summary: The journey becomes more upbeat, and Lysandra admits to Ephanna that she is struggling with leadership. The group then notices they are all humming the same tune, which is identified as the Dustwalker’s festival song, before reaching the Mireward fork.

evidence_refs.label: Morale lifts, and the shared song is recognized

beats.title: Abandoned restaurant provides shelter from hail
beats.summary: The party inspects a recently abandoned meat-on-a-stick restaurant, finds signs of a hurried departure, and shelters there as Karsemine reinforces the structure. A massive hail wall hits and then passes.

evidence_refs.label: Abandoned restaurant provides shelter from hail

beats.title: A door-knock omen and another troubling city update
beats.summary: After the storm, the group resumes travel and hears unexplained knocking with no visible source. Ephanna then receives another Grobnok call reporting an unstable truce in the city, growing Shepherd recruitment, and a gnome showing shimmering eyes.

evidence_refs.label: A door-knock omen and another troubling city update
A door-knock omen and another troubling city update

beats.title: Lysandra’s stated mission and a guarded wall ahead
beats.summary: Stafl uses Suggestion to probe Lysandra’s intentions, and she says she wants the team focused on reaching the swamp and destroying the cult source. Soon after, the party finds a wall and a guard who demands identification.

evidence_refs.label: Lysandra’s stated mission and a guarded wall ahead

beats.title: The guard is revealed as Lysandra’s father
beats.summary: Once the guard gets a better look at the party, he recognizes Lysandra as his daughter, revealing himself to be Lysandro and reintroducing the family connection in the scene.

evidence_refs.label: The guard is revealed as Lysandra’s father
